acceptance.given: A frozen test-case binding declares compiler-assigned CER assertion IDs and its parameterized cases.

oracle.expected: The structured CER case-evidence report maps every case, including every parameter instance, to its exact assertion IDs and records its execution.
forbidden: A case is not bound to its exact CER assertion IDs.
A parameter instance is omitted from execution.
A shared-helper marker claims coverage for an unexecuted case.
oracle.observable: The CER case-evidence report and assertion-coverage mapping expose exact case-to-assertion bindings and executed parameter instances.

acceptance.then: Every case and parameter instance has explicit, matching CER assertion coverage.
acceptance.when: The frozen CER binding is evaluated against the pytest case-evidence report.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the CER case-evidence selector and require failure when exact assertion IDs are missing, parameter instances are deselected or absent, or shared-helper markers substitute for case execution.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require explicit CER assertion bindings and execution records for every parameterized case.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema change; restore the prior case-evidence binding behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Frozen assertion bindings are compared with collected and executed CER case records.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: CER validation confirms exact assertion-ID coverage for every case and execution coverage for every parameter instance.
